texts.name: The Walking Wood
texts.blurb: A forest that does not stay where you left it.

raw.name: The wood walks
raw.blurb: Every two minutes roots close three ways and open three others. A glow marks the ways that are open.

people.name: The Moss-Abbess
greet: Careful, climber. The wood walks, and only my horn keeps it from walking over us. Three wisps are bound in it, and the Elder Root at its heart is hungry.

people.name: The Path-Lighter
greet: I lose things in this wood, and the wood keeps them. Maybe you can bring them back.

people.name: The Amber-Seller
greet: Shards for what you need. The wood takes nothing back, so I take shards.

quests.name: The Heart of the Wood
intro: Free three wisps: stand by each one and it follows you. Lead them to the heart. Then cut the three roots that feed the Elder Root, and its door opens.
outro: The wisps are home, the roots are cut. The Elder Root’s door stands open, far in the north. Rest first, then go in.

steps.text: Free the wisp in the hounds’ den and lead it to the heart
steps.name: The wisp

steps.text: Free the wisp in the bramble and lead it to the heart
steps.name: The wisp

steps.text: Free the wisp in the thicket and lead it to the heart
steps.name: The wisp

steps.text: Cut the three roots that feed the Elder Root
Go to the Elder Root’s door

quests.name: The Hollow Oak
intro: An oak walks the old road to the heart. Hollow, and a hundred winters old. Fell it and the wood grows calmer.
outro: A relic from an oak. Keep it.

quests.name: The Spore Lamps
intro: Two spore lamps stand in the glades west and east of the camp. Light both, stand by each a moment, and I can see where the paths have gone.
outro: Now I can see. Take this, it was in the dirt.

quests.name: The Lost Spade
intro: My spade lies in the bramble, where the thorns took it. Carry it back to the camp fire. A hit and you drop it.
outro: My spade! Here, for the trouble.

steps.text: Bring the Path-Lighter’s spade from the bramble to the fire

doors.name: The Elder Root’s door
doors.locked: Roots hold the door shut. The Moss-Abbess has a quest about the wisps.

doors.name: The gate up
doors.locked: The gate is sealed. Its warden answers only once the Elder Root has fallen.

lines: Another climber. I am Nyx, and I hunt in the dark. Walk through the arch behind me and we see who is quicker. Win, and I fight beside you.

lore.name: The root stone
text: The wood was a field once. It walked away from the plough and has been walking since.
What you take for paths are roots, and what you take for roots are paths.

hound.name: Bark hound
hound.blurb: Fast, and hunts in a pack.

oak.name: The Hollow Oak
oak.blurb: Walks the old road and strikes hard.

root.name: Feeding root
root.blurb: A root that feeds the Elder Root. It cannot move; it throws thorns.

ruler.name: The Elder Root
ruler.title: The heart of the wood
ruler.line: Cut the roots that feed it; it stands open when none is left
